data.narrative:
ISEE, a Series B autonomous systems company, is the subject of this valuation. The target operates in Drones & Autonomous, a sector populated by 8 private peers including Joby Aviation, Archer Aviation, Zipline, Elroy Air, and Nuro. No public comparables exist in the narrowly defined peer set.

With $70M in total capital raised to date, a stage-progression approach is the applicable valuation method. This framework applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier from Series B to the anticipated next funding round, using total raised as a proxy for current enterprise value. This methodology yields an implied valuation of $133M. A peer-median approach could not be reliably applied; while five same-sector companies exist, fewer than three comparable transactions met narrow filters (same-stage or adjacent-stage with similar valuation tier), rendering sector-wide medians potentially misleading given heterogeneity in technology maturity and go-to-market models.

The triangulation supports a valuation range of $113M to $153M, centered at $133M. The median reflects the single defensible quantitative method available. Key uncertainties include capital efficiency relative to private peers, time-to-revenue trajectory, and regulatory pathway clarity—factors not captured in the stage-progression approach alone. A more precise range would require either comparable transaction data from adjacent-stage companies in autonomous systems or detailed margin and growth assumptions from financial projections.
